name: Collard Greens

companions.note: Borage repels cabbage worms that heavily target collards
Alliums deter aphids, a common collard pest

pnw_notes: The most cold-hardy of the common brassica greens — even hardier than kale in sustained freezes. Flavor sweetens dramatically after frost. Large, substantial leaves good for cooking or wrapping. Long season plant; start in summer for fall/winter harvest. Needs more vertical space than kale — consider bed position carefully.

frost_hardiness.notes: The most cold-hardy common brassica — even hardier than kale. Flavor peaks after sustained frost.

planting_windows.notes: Start 4–6 weeks before outdoor transplant date
Transplant while still warm enough to establish before fall
Harvest lower leaves; plant continues producing from the top through winter
